data.title: Design, Supply, Installation and Commissioning of Grid-Tied Solar PV Systems (5 MW Aggregate) at Twelve Public Hospitals
data.summary: The Energy Department, Government of Punjab is seeking proposals to design, supply, install, test and commission grid-tied solar PV systems totaling 5 MW across twelve public hospitals. The scope includes site surveys, engineering design, Tier-1 equipment supply, civil/electrical works, SCADA-based monitoring, net-metering approvals with DISCOs, staff training, and comprehensive operations and maintenance for three years with performance guarantees.

data.submission_instructions: Procurement Method: Single Stage  Two Envelope (PPRA Rules 2014). Proposals shall be submitted in two separate sealed envelopes marked "Technical Proposal" and "Financial Proposal", one original and two copies each, addressed to the Section Officer (Procurement), Energy Department, Government of Punjab, Lahore.
